title: OpenClaw Autonomous Coding: Let Your Agent Fix Bugs and Open PRs While You Sleep
summary: OpenClaw autonomous coding agent fixes bugs, opens PRs, and runs overnight tasks 24/7. Step-by-step developer setup guide with real GitHub automation workflows.
body_markdown: Yes. OpenClaw only works on bugs when it's running. If your agent is on a laptop that sleeps, it can only process issues when the laptop is open. For overnight autonomous work, you need a persistent runtime — either a VPS you manage yourself, or managed hosting like Blink Claw which keeps your agent running 24/7 without any infrastructure work.
